core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hakim is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Wise, all-wise”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hakim corresponds to the Arabic form حكيم (Arabic root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m); حَكِيم (Ḥakīm)). Its core sense is wise, discerning, all-wise. Hakim is Arabic حَكِيم (Ḥakīm) 'wise, all-wise', from the root ح ك م (ḥ-k-m). The source gloss 'wise' is correct. In South Asian usage حكيم also denotes a practitioner of traditional medicine (a title rather than a lexical sense of the name).
